learned_rules:
- **Rating scale (owner: press clean setups).** If the hard lines pass, flow is live and the first target is at least 1.5x away, rate it 7. A 5–6 is a probe. Under 5 is a PASS, and every PASS names its blocker.
- **The proven shape rates 8: a MIGRATED flow leader 25–45% off the local high.** It needs all of: a higher-low base above the hourly low, 5m volume at least $10k and at or above the hourly pace, more buys than sells, top 10 under 15%, low RugCheck bundles. If a live meta still has the crowd arriving, it's a 9. All 3 wins came from this band: CATBOT 4.44x, FLOATER 2.19x, SWAN scratch. Lean on it (V1, V6, V13).
- **MIGRATED band is 10–60% off the local high** (owner). Within 10% of the high is a PASS, blocker "chasing" (near-high skips: 8 ran, 33 dumped).
- **The shallow band (10–25% off the high) is a breakout trade, capped at 7.** Flow leader only, and price must be pushing into the high right now. Otherwise PASS, blocker "no breakout". The band is 0 for 4 (HYPERCHAN x2, PILLSEY, PAWCAT).
- **A spike counts as chasing anywhere in the band.** If the last 5m candle is up more than 25%, or volume is over 3x the hourly pace, wait for the retrace and a higher low (PILLSEY −31%, V1).
- **Confirm the entry and the flow.** The higher low or base must already be printed. On MIGRATED, 5m must be at or above the hourly pace at entry. Flow below pace is a PASS (blocker "flow below pace"), never a probe. 6 of 16 losers never went green, and HYPERCHAN, BLUE and AAPLCAT were all bought below pace.
- **Rate on the first resistance, not the dream.** The nearest prior high, POC or 0.618 level must be at least 1.5x above entry. Otherwise PASS, blocker "target below initials" (PAWCAT, SWAN, and losers that peaked at 1.09–1.40x).
- **Fresh migration under 1h that is bleeding off the bond spike: wait for a base above the hourly low** (too-new skips: 6 ran, 49 dumped; SI −38%, V1).
- **Vamp field: buy only the leader by 5m volume and attention.** A noted bundle cluster inside a big same-ticker field is a PASS (vamp skips: 1 ran, 5 dumped; BLUE, V1, V3).
- **A DIP needs a visible higher low.** That means a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, then price back above that pullback low, with the stop under it. Never buy the first red-to-green candle. A close under the higher low ends the thesis, so sell (no-higher-low skips: 2 ran, 13 dumped).
- **DIP gate: attention, story and depth.** 5m at least 0.7x the hourly average (owner; code enforces it), drawdown 40–70%, and a live story with the crowd still arriving. A thin tech/LARP dip is a PASS, blocker "dead story". If the catalyst already printed (news rebrand, half-priced), it rates a probe at most until it reclaims the pullback high (SIS). DIPs are 0 for 5, so a DIP only rates 8+ with the full proven shape.
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 over 25%, dev over 1%, bundles/insiders over the line, mint/freeze live, LP not burned, political figure, RugCheck danger or not loading, any hack/exploit/drain story (owner; V6, V13, V17). Every one of these skip groups mostly dumped.
- **Protect green trades before initials.** If I'm green and 5m drops under half its hourly pace, sell half (CPU and FLOAT peaked around 1.6x and closed red). If a stop review fires on a trade that already hit 1.3x, sell all of it, never half (PILLSEY).
- **Time stop: exit at the clock if under 1.0x with no volume surge** (V1). One extension to 90 min, only if all of these hold: mcap over $1M, at least 1.08x on mcap, holding the range low, and 5m at or above the hourly pace (FLOAT sat 158 min and lost).
- **A stop review defaults to SELL, immediately.** Always sell if the trade never went green, the reason is "unclear", or the top-10/insider share dropped while price bleeds. All 7 stop reviews closed worse than the stop (−27% to −59%). Hold once only if the bundle exit is visible, the trade went green first, and story plus 5m are clearly intact. Re-enter a stopped coin only on a reclaim of its prior high (CATBOT buy-back −24%).
